property.name: note
property.value:
Parameters in use:
inBattle - Simple binary state check to see if the player has entered a "battle state"; 1 means in battle, 0 means out of battle. You can just tie this to any existing state check in-engine.
Battle Phase - Simple binary state change between Planning (0) and Resolution (1). Unlike tutorial battle, this is used to transition between two different tracks on the timeline. Transitions are set-up in the region itself, so simply changing the value from 0 to 1 should facilitate the change.
battleSkipIntro - A bit of an experiment, but in cases where you might want to forgo that 4-measure intro, this state check makes it so that the field music transitions right into battlePrep. Could be useful in overworld testing in back-to-back battle sequences
